paragraphs.en: Open Source Introductory Systems Programming Textbook for the University of Illinois
paragraphs.zh: 伊利诺伊大学开源系统编程入门教材

paragraphs.en: Welcome to the systems programming coursebook! This repository houses a high-quality, open-source introductory systems programming textbook used by the CS 341: System Programming course at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign The book assumes that you have taken a programming language course and are familiar with assembly instructions. All of the code and instruction will be in C, as it is the de-facto language of the Linux Kernel.
paragraphs.zh: 欢迎阅读系统编程教材！ 本仓库托管了一本高质量的开源系统编程入门教材，供伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校的 CS 341：系统编程课程使用。本书假设你已经修过一门编程语言课程，并熟悉汇编指令。 所有代码和讲解都将使用 C 语言，因为它是 Linux 内核的事实标准语言。
